notes.title: Huge Update
notes.content:
[h1]After a longer break, I would like to present to you a new update that significantly impacts the gameplay, bringing diversity and adding new functionalities. Below is the list of new features:[/h1]

[h3]-Enemies can drop grenades upon death. There are three types of grenades that, when collected, have different effects: freezing enemies, igniting enemies, and exploding with an impulse.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876820/fcb652d80d1235cf28774abec7e98b56c0499684.gif[/img]

[h3]-Enemies can drop new items upon death:[/h3]
[list]
[*] a)Magnet: attracts all items on the map.
[*] b)Infinite ammo for 30 seconds.
[*] c)Medkit: heals the player.
[/list]

[h3]-Introducing the new "Combo" mechanic. Now, destroyed enemies are counted, and upon reaching a count of 20 without losing health, the player receives increased speed and damage.[/h3]

[h3]-New passive weapon: Rocket Launcher. Rockets automatically target enemies and attack them without player intervention.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876820/2a03f711657ee6554c52f05fd06dfcb8885e7828.gif[/img]

[h3]-The game now offers a windowed view option in the settings.[/h3]

[h3]-Towers now have their own health bar, which regenerates after being upgraded.[/h3]

[h3]-A completely new type of enemy that throws poison at the player.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876820/2479d3ba1bda7c63d22e5c68abbae7ba706d680d.gif[/img]

[h3]-Towers now find the shortest rotation path when selecting a new target for attack.[/h3]

[h3]-Missing sounds have been added to the game.[/h3]

[h3]-Added support for gamepad controls.[/h3]

[h2]-Four bosses have been added, appearing in certain campaign levels as well as the survival mode.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876820/d9e667bb6ed616f46f9b8b68faa2e854140f045d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876820/d0ec484d6e36fd08c33ea68646b21c151dde3112.gif[/img]

[h3]-Significant improvements in game optimization.[/h3]

[h3]-Gameplay balance has been improved.[/h3]

[h2]-A completely new gameplay mechanic: Every 60 seconds, the player is given the opportunity to randomly select a gameplay modifier. Some modifiers benefit the player, while others may make the gameplay more challenging. There are a total of 15 modifiers to choose from. [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43876820/2a808672b720b74873ecd83572db5f8507596992.gif[/img]

[h3]Here are a few examples:[/h3]
[list]
[*] a) "Storm is Coming": Enemies take damage from lightning.
[*] b) "This is How It's Born": Enemies spawn eggs that hatch into new enemies when collected.
[*] c) "What Do They Feed Them?": Enemies are 3 times larger.
[*] d) "Lucky Day": Enemies spawn 3 times more coins.
[/list]

-Fixed a lot of bugs
